name: scopedesk
description: ScopeDesk: Secure Task-Bounded Remote Support Desktop Application

scripts.build: npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop run build
scripts.build:win: npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop run build:win
scripts.build:mac: npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop run build:mac
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix desktop test && npm --prefix agent test
